shared_elements: large carved stone monument displayed on a plinth in a museum interior
single dominant anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole field
low-relief incised detail on a brown/grey stone surface
circular/disc motifs (rosette-like bracelet on A, concentric discs on B)
suggestion of headgear or crest above the head
indication of held/worn objects and bands across the body
justification: Both present one upright anthropomorphic figure filling the entire carved surface, with relief-cut circular ornaments and banding across the torso, and both are photographed as museum objects on plinths. The manner of execution differs sharply: A is a thin, flat wall slab with crisp, fine linear relief showing a profile winged figure with feathered detail, while B is a massive weathered three-dimensional boulder-like block with a frontal, blocky, heavily eroded design.
